messages:
Evan: Morning team — thinking of a tiny 'office tri' today: 10min row, 8min boulder drills, 6min easy loop around the block. 12:15 start. whos in?
Sasha: count me in for the boulder drills. will bring a spare chalk ball.
Marta: love it. ill do the row and the run, need low-impact boulder options though.
Leo: will join. can we do teams so people swap stations? keeps it social.
Viv: remote but will post a cheering playlist. :headphones:
climbbot: Reminder: garage wall etiquette  please wipe holds if you use chalk and avoid overloading pads.
Riley: bringing ankle straps just in case. also mini poll: protein bar after? peanut butter vs almond vs vegan oat? react with :peanut: :almond: :oat: to vote.
Samir: peanut for me. also can someone print a 4-exercise warmup?
Evan: warmup idea: 3min light row, 2x30s shoulder circles, hip swings, 2x10 scapular pulls.
Sasha: teams: me + Marta vs Leo + Riley? rotate every 8 minutes.
Marta: sounds good. ill tape a tiny scoreboard on the whiteboard for attempts + smiles. :grin:
Leo: RSVP'd on calendar. any cap on participants? worried about crowding the garage.
Evan: let's keep it to 8 max today. first-come-first-served on the sheet.
Viv: playlist posted: https://tiny.redwood/triple-threat-12. also good stretch vid: https://youtu.be/stretch-3
Samir: bringing a camera for slow-mo beta on footwork if people want. will blur faces on request.
Riley: poll closing in 10min. ill pick up 4 bars after the session.
climbbot: FYI: maintenance window tomorrow 9am for garage lighting. avoid evening sessions then.
Marta: leaving desk 12:05. see you all soon!
Evan: see you. quick note: bring water bottle and label shoes. last month we had a mixup.
Sasha: noted. grateful for the sticker label pack. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
